exposure.needed: whether external-secrets is installed or managed via OLM (Operator Lifecycle Manager) rather than Helm or raw manifests

original.statement: The v0.16.0 release notes list under BREAKING CHANGES the removal of the OLM (Operator Lifecycle Manager) installation and release documentation (PR #4617).

decision.reason: [ev-2e2644c3f5f9] says only that the OLM installation and release docs were removed. It does not say that OLM installation stopped working or that any setting, artifact or support relationship changed. The section is titled "BREAKING CHANGES", but that heading covers every item, including dependabot bumps [ev-ade0be673ee4] [ev-86762bb5fcce], so it does not show this item is breaking. The proposed undecidable leaf uses a reason that is not allowed ("environment-visibility-gap") and depends on whether the install method is visible, which the rules forbid. No exposure condition follows from a documentation-only removal.
